normalization_requirements: Every row must carry opaque_options and standalone_projection_source.opaque_options.
Every row must retain semantic target value and role metadata.
Every replay row must declare source_row_id and source_stage12086_direction.
No semantic target value visible before candidates.
Deterministic option shuffle must be asserted or inherited from the source row.

candidate_selection_gain_preservation.hard_negative: Stage11924 base_pred_role/base_pred_value for the same row
candidate_selection_gain_preservation.purpose: Avoid undoing genuine candidate-selection gains while repairing losses.

candidate_selection_regression_replay.hard_negative: Stage12083 post_pred_role/post_pred_value for the same row
candidate_selection_regression_replay.primary_sources: all Stage12086 candidate-selection losses, cycled only after full coverage
candidate_selection_regression_replay.purpose: Recover candidate-selection rows lost by Stage12083, especially verifier/build-vs-surface cases.

next_action_gain_preservation.purpose: Preserve the Stage12083 next-action improvement of 51/160 -> 59/160.

selected_verifier_next_action_preservati.hard_negative: Stage12083 wrong post prediction, commonly PLAN_PATCH

selected_verifier_next_action_preservati.purpose: Prevent the repair from repeating Stage12075/12083 selected-verifier overcorrection.

design_reference.sampling_rule: Coverage first, cycling second: cover all 24 candidate-selection losses before duplicating any loss row. Do not allow next-action preservation rows to exceed 50% of the packet.
